mapper.select: select id, name, course, os, software_list as softwareList, labs, status, tag_type as tagType, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from environment_template order by id desc
select id, name, course, os, software_list as softwareList, labs, status, tag_type as tagType, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from environment_template where id = #{id}

select id, name, course, os, software_list as softwareList, labs, status, tag_type as tagType, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from environment_template where course = #{course} order by id desc limit 1
SELECT DISTINCT teacher AS teacherName FROM class_timetable WHERE teacher IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(teacher) != '' ORDER BY teacher
mapper.insert: insert into environment_template ( name, course, os, software_list, labs, status, tag_type ) values ( #{name}, #{course}, #{os}, #{softwareList}, #{labs}, coalesce(#{status}, '试运行'), coalesce(#{tagType}, 'primary') )
mapper.update: update environment_template set name = #{template.name}, course = #{template.course}, os = #{template.os}, software_list = #{template.softwareList}, labs = #{template.labs}, status = #{template.status}, tag_type = #{template.tagType}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
